name: Hibina
source: His official name is God Hibina. He’s one of the deities worshipped at the shrine in the recess of the mountains, where the Hakuseki clan used to live. His role is to “connect ties.” Even though he’s serious and relentless, he’s basically a good person. He treasures Hibie more than anyone else.
